title: 词重音
goal: 按规则判断词的重音位置；区分重音不同的同形词。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 口语

points.label: 按规则判断词的重音位置
区分重音不同的同形词

body.p: 词重音是一个词里读得最突出的那个音节，不是把整个词读响。大写的部分是主重音所在的音节。本课用书面标记考重音位置，不用录音判断。

body.box:
REcord（名词） / reCORD（动词）
The record is incomplete. / Please record the result.

body.p: 有些同形词作名词和作动词时重音位置不同。后缀和复合词也能提示重音位置。具体词的读音要逐个记。本课四张表共列 40 个词。

cards.title: 词汇表：同形词
rows: Keep a record. / Record each result.
A permit is required. / The rules permit entry.
The present was wrapped. / Present the findings.
The produce is fresh. / The cells produce heat.
The object is heavy. / Residents object to the plan.
The subject is complex. / Do not subject it to heat.
Her conduct was professional. / Conduct a survey.
The project is complete. / Project the image onto the wall.
An increase was reported. / Costs may increase.
cards.note: 这些双音节词作名词时主重音在前，作动词时在后。这条规律只适用于表中这类词。

cards.title: 词汇表：后缀
rows: Education can broaden access to skilled work.
-ic 前一音节；形容词：经济的
-ic 前一音节；形容词：科学的
-ee 自带主重音；名词：受训者
三音节 -ate 动词；动词：产生
三音节 -ate 动词；动词：说明
cards.note: -tion、-ic、-ity 前面的音节常重读。-ee 本身常重读。本表的三音节 -ate 动词重读倒数第三音节。create 重读末音节，不按这条规律。

cards.title: 词汇表：复合名词
rows: The diagram remained on the blackboard.
The seedlings grew in a greenhouse.
The keyboard has a damaged key.
Annual rainfall varies across the region.
The deadline applies to every application.
The feedback identified two unclear claims.
cards.note: 本表复合名词的主重音在第一部分。greenhouse 是温室。green house 是绿色的房子，不是复合名词。

cards.title: 词汇表：学术常用词
rows: The hypothesis predicts a clear difference.
The evidence supports a narrower claim.
The phenomenon occurs under specific conditions.
One consequence was a longer waiting time.
cards.note: 派生词的重音位置可能和原词不同，如 ANalyze 和 aNALysis。本表只标主重音，不标次重音。

body.box:
The team will present a present to the retiring archivist.
Which pair matches the two uses?
1. PREsent / PREsent
2. preSENT / PREsent
3. PREsent / preSENT
4. preSENT / preSENT

body.p: will 后的 present 是动词，主重音在后。a 后的 present 是名词，主重音在前。答案是第二项。

groups.text: The intern will record the interview in a written record.

items.stem: Which pair marks record in sentence order?
items.why: will record 为动词，written record 为名词；前者后重，后者前重。

groups.text: The contract allows the material to contract when cooled.

items.stem: Which pair matches the noun and the verb?
items.why: The contract 是合同，to contract 是收缩；名词前重、动词后重。

groups.text: The two terms are education and scientific.

items.stem: Which pair follows the suffix patterns?
items.why: education 与 scientific 分别在 -tion、-ic 前的音节重读。

groups.text: The word pair is generate and notebook.

items.stem: Which pair has the taught primary stress?
items.why: GENerate 是所列三音节 -ate 动词；NOTEbook 的主重音在复合词第一部分。

groups.text: The proposal concerns an increase in costs that may increase again.

items.stem: Which pair matches the two uses of increase?
items.why: an increase 是名词，may increase 是动词，重音分别在前和后。

groups.text: The two words are ability and trainee.

items.stem: Which pair follows the -ity and -ee patterns?
items.why: ability 重读 -ity 前的音节；trainee 重读 -ee。

groups.text: The course introduces analysis and evidence.

items.stem: Which pair matches the academic-word table?
items.why: aNALysis 的主重音在第二音节，EVidence 在第一音节。

groups.text: The produce stall hopes to produce less packaging waste.

items.stem: Which pair fits the meanings in order?
items.why: produce stall 中 produce 指农产品，to produce 表示产生；词性和重音均不同。

groups.text: The curator will present a small present at the farewell event.

items.stem: Which pair marks present in sentence order?
items.why: will present 是动词，a small present 是名词，分别后重和前重。

groups.text: The permit will permit entry to the fossil preparation room.

items.stem: Which pair matches the two uses of permit?
items.why: The permit 是名词，will permit 是动词；前者前重，后者后重。

groups.text: The conservator will object if the object is moved.

items.stem: Which pair fits the two uses of object?
items.why: will object 表示反对，the object 指物体，分别为动词后重和名词前重。

groups.text: The panel praised her conduct during the study she helped conduct.

items.stem: Which pair matches conduct in sentence order?
items.why: her conduct 是名词行为，helped conduct 中为动词开展；两个词的主重音不同。

groups.text: The assigned terms are discussion and economic.

items.stem: Which pair follows the taught suffix patterns?
items.why: discussion 在 -sion 前重读，economic 在 -ic 前重读；两词都不是后缀自身重读。

groups.text: The vocabulary list contains activity and employee.

items.stem: Which pair has the correct primary stress?
items.why: activity 的重音在 -ity 前，employee 的主重音在 -ee。

groups.text: The paired terms are illustrate and feedback.

items.stem: Which pair follows the patterns taught here?
items.why: ILLustrate 重读倒数第三音节，FEEDback 的主重音在复合词第一部分。

groups.text: The research summary uses hypothesis and significant.

items.stem: Which pair matches the academic-word table?
items.why: hyPOthesis 与 sigNIFicant 的主重音均在第二音节；大写标明该音节。
